svg.desc: Cooling from 80 toward 20 degrees follows rate 0.4 per minute. The 35-degree crossing occurs at about 3.466 minutes. Linear interpolation from two-minute samples differs from the exact curve between samples; the lower panel displays that error explicitly.
svg.title: ODE solution, crossing time and interpolation error
